meta.name: volcanic_caldera_lake
meta.prompt: A volcanic caldera lake with black-sand shores, steaming vents along the rim and a lava tube opening on the outer slope — no settlement of any kind.

programs.brief: A small steaming volcanic fumarole vent built from rough basalt, blackstone, and magma blocks with smoke rising continuously from a concealed hot vent.

tokens.terrain: a deep caldera lake enclosed by a circular volcanic crater rim with black-sand shores; steaming vents and fumaroles along the rim; a lava tube cave opening on the outer slope
tokens.nature: pristine volcanic wilderness with no settlement, buildings, or roads of any kind
